name: Swedish B2
description:
In this module, students will increase their knowledge of Swedish as a foreign language, enabling them to actively and almost fluently communicate with a native speaker on topics of general interest or in familiar fields using logically-structured arguments.

Students review and deepen their knowledge of deponent verbs (verbs ending in -s), transitive and intransitive verbs, passive with 's' and passive with perfect participles, adverbs and conjuncitons.

Students learn the following new grammar elements: phrasal verbs, syntax/ word order in complex main and subordinate clauses with multiple compliments.
prerequisites: Passing grade on final exam at level B1
